lines.en: I walk slowly, the book held to my chest.

lines.zh: 袍子拖过沙地，留下一道印。
lines.en: My robe drags the sand, leaving a line.
The pages turn by themselves.
I count my steps and recite names.

lines.zh: 死物听得见我，活物不一定。
lines.en: The dead hear me. The living may not.
I walk half around the grave soil.

lines.zh: 这里的土，翻过很多次了。
lines.en: This earth has been turned many times.
I head where the death-smell is.
My fingers tap the spine.
Grass doesn't grow where I've walked.
I move slowly. No hurry.

lines.zh: 书里有个声音，在给我指路。
lines.en: A voice in the book is pointing the way.
I stand and turn a page.
The letters rearrange themselves as I watch.

lines.zh: 我念一句，地上就动一下。
lines.en: I recite a line and the ground shifts.
This book is heavy. Heavier than it looks.
The wind lifts the hem of my robe.
Something under the soil is waiting for me.
I don't need a torch.
The page edges are worn shiny.

lines.zh: 我合上书，听见土里有回音。
lines.en: I close the book and hear an echo underground.

lines.zh: 有一个名字，我总念不对。
lines.en: There's one name I never get right.
I write it in the sand.
Wrong. I wipe it out and write again.
At night the book is clearest.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有人在哭。
lines.en: Someone is weeping far away.

lines.zh: 这不关我的事，可我还是听。
lines.en: Not my concern, but I listen.
I wait for the soil to loosen.
You're alive. That's obvious.
I see few living people these days.
There's no death-smell on you.
You fear me. I'm used to it.
I don't collect debts from the living.
Step back. Don't cross that circle.
I'm reciting. Don't speak yet.
What do you want to ask?
I'd advise you not to touch this book.
I can hear your name.
I don't need it. Just listening.
Stand back. The soil is about to move.
The warmth of the living gets in the way.
My book's pages turn themselves.
Watching is fine. Just don't make a sound.
Let me finish this page first.
There. You may ask now.
The book fell. I snatch it up.
That made me misread two lines.
I withdraw outside the circle and steady.

lines.zh: 我的血是黑的，流得很慢。
lines.en: My blood is black. It runs slowly.
Don't touch the book. It's worse than I am.
The soil's disturbed. I must redraw.

lines.zh: 我跪下来，把书压在膝上。
lines.en: I kneel and press the book to my knee.
If I can't recite, I'll remember.

lines.zh: 血流到书页上，被吸干了。
lines.en: My blood soaks the page and is drunk dry.
I'll stand again.

lines.zh: 我吃的是名字，不是面包。
lines.en: I feed on names, not bread.
Leave it on the ground. I'll glance at it.

lines.zh: 这本书记的事，比食物要紧。
lines.en: What this book records matters more than food.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡住圈了，往左。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the circle; move left.

lines.zh: 我对活人的东西没兴趣。
lines.en: The things of the living don't interest me.
Unless there's death-smell on it.
Put it away; it covers the incantation.
I won't take this.
If you're giving it, put it outside the circle.
I'll remember the gesture.
You bumped my book.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我手上还拿着东西。
lines.en: Don't. My hands are full.
That made me misread a line.
You're standing on the circle.
I turn aside for you. Slowly.
We brushed past. You're very warm.
Get back. The soil is turning.

lines.zh: 你踩住袍角，我停下念咒。
lines.en: You step on my hem and I stop the chant.
Stand further off. It isn't safe here.
I caught the book. It didn't fall.
Someone like me doesn't speak of this.
You're alive. I'm half-dead.
The book doesn't cover this.
Try standing inside the circle.
Don't be afraid. I won't do anything.
The company of the living is short.
I can wait. I can wait a long time.
Your shadow falls on my book.
Let it stay there.
Leave before dawn. I won't stop you.
I bend, the book still under my arm.
No death-smell. I don't want it.
A page. It fits in the book.
I press it into the soil.
Bones mustn't be moved carelessly.
Whose bone is this?
I'll set it outside the circle. Don't bring it in.
Very heavy. I drag it to the circle.

lines.zh: 这一页写着别人的名字。
lines.en: This page has someone else's name.
I've noted this page.
The soil moved.
I'm at the third line.
Something's climbing up.

lines.zh: 它没有名字，我要给它一个。
lines.en: It has no name. I'll give it one.
The book opened to the right page.
I raise a hand and draw a circle.

lines.zh: 土已经松了，你踩上去正好。
lines.en: The soil is loose, and you stepped right on it.
This isn't aimed at you.
Unless you stand in its way.
I've finished this page.
Rise from the soil.
The soil loosened. The hour has come.
I keep reciting. The voice doesn't stop.
The soil loosens, bit by bit.
No need to run. It can't chase.
It goes only where I point.

lines.zh: 暗之精华在指间转，算着距离。
lines.en: Dark essence turns in my fingers as I gauge distance.
That circle isn't quite round.
One more stroke needed.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，刚好在边上。
lines.en: You're standing right on the edge.
I saw that step of yours.
One more step back and you're safe.
You stand on the circle's edge, unmoved.
Then don't say I didn't warn you.
You don't step back. I go on reciting.
The page turned itself.
This page is finished.

lines.zh: 我把书合上，声音就断了。
lines.en: I close the book, and the sound cuts off.
The spine comes down. Heavy.

lines.zh: 我抓住你手腕，指节发白。
lines.en: I grip your wrist, knuckles pale.
My hand is cold. Don't struggle.
I say one word and your strength goes.
This isn't a blow. It's a taking.
I need only a little.
I'll borrow a little of your warmth.
Don't move; the circle isn't finished.
I borrow a breath; it's returned soon.
I come from behind the dune.
The book opens first. Then I move.

lines.zh: 恶地的红，衬得袍子更黑。
lines.en: Against red badlands my robe looks blacker.
I draw the first circle in the sand.
What's in the soil knows me.
The wind sets the pages flapping.
I speak the first name.
A small mound rises in the ground.
The Midnight Necronomicon is in my hand.
People were buried on this beach.
I hold the book close and go in.
Bamboo roots have loosened the soil.

lines.zh: 埋在沙下的人，这里正好。
lines.en: Buried under the sand. This spot will do.
I turn to that page.
The letters move. That means yes.

lines.zh: 我抬手，沙里浮出一行字。
lines.en: I raise a hand and a line of script rises from the sand.

lines.zh: 火烧到书角，我用手按灭了。
lines.en: Fire caught a corner. I smothered it with my hand.
I fell, the book shielded against my chest.
Water soaked the pages. The letters bled.
The blast scattered the pages.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过袍子，钉进肩里。
lines.en: Something went through the robe into my shoulder.
That light was brighter than my book.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我也会枯。
lines.en: I don't eat, but I do wither.
Lightning struck the book. My hand went numb.

lines.zh: 没有土，我的手艺使不出来。
lines.en: No soil here; my craft has nothing to work with.
